title: Cinderella Chef
description: Ye Jiayao finds herself back in time in the body of Ye Jinxuan. After many twists, she thought that she would finally be able to lead a simple life and achieve her dream of opening the best restaurant in Huai Song. However, there are villains constantly trying to bring her down.

episodes_data.title: Cinderella Chef Season 1 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Ye Jiayao, a cooking prodigy, has had a terrible accident but it turns out she's traveled back in time!

episodes_data.title: Cinderella Chef Season 1 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: Ye Jinxuan is held captive in Black Wind Hamlet, a bandit village, as the wife of the Third Master.

episodes_data.title: Cinderella Chef Season 3 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: After the events of the last season, Ye Jiayao finally becomes engaged to Xia Chunyu. Unexpectedly, Chamberlain Ping shows up with an Imperial Edict. What does the Emperor want with Yaoyao?

episodes_data.title: Cinderella Chef Season 3 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: Yaoyao impresses the Emperor with her cooking at Princess Liuli's birthday banquet. The Emperor sends Chunyu to the Nanyue Kingdom.

episodes_data.title: Cinderella Chef Season 3 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Yaoyao sets off to Nanyue to meet up with Chunyu. On the way, she meets Jing.

episodes_data.title: Cinderella Chef Season 3 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: Ye Jiayao heads with Jing towards Nanyue to meet Xia Chunyu. Along the way, several refugees from Nanyue begin to appear.

episodes_data.title: Cinderella Chef Season 3 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: With Ah Ruan as their guide, Yaoyao, Chunyu and Jing set off on their journey to the Nanyue Kingdom.

episodes_data.title: Cinderella Chef Season 3 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Yaoyao, Jing and Ah Ruan continue to make their way to the Nanyue Kingdom.

episodes_data.title: Cinderella Chef Season 3 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: Yaoyao impresses the king of the Nanyue Kingdom with her cooking skills.

episodes_data.title: Cinderella Chef Season 3 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: Yaoyao, Jing and Ah Ruan begin their journey back to Jinling.

episodes_data.title: Cinderella Chef Season 3 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: Yaoyao impresses the Emperor with her cooking inspired by the journey to Nanyue in preparation for the Banquet of Nations.

episodes_data.title: Cinderella Chef Season 3 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: Yaoyao visits Chunyu's house after finding out that his mother is sick.

episodes_data.title: Cinderella Chef Season 3 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: Yaoyao stays up all night preparing for the Banquet of Nations, ensuring that it is a success.

episodes_data.title: Cinderella Chef Season 3 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: Finally, it's the day of the wedding!
